text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер is ecstatic that she was able
to
surpass Токай Тэйо in the Wakagoma
Stakes and
lets out a shout of joy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, seeing Токай Тэйо's positive
attitude
even in defeat instantly
dampens her mood.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She concludes that she was only able to
win
because of luck.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I suggest a trip to enter a local race, the
Kokura
Kinen, to give her more
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
